name: Chroma Noise Reduction
description: Port of FFmpeg's chromanr filter: reduce chrominance noise by averaging the chroma of similar neighbouring pixels.

params.name: thres
params.description: Threshold on the Y+U+V distance, 0..255 scale

params.name: sizew
params.description: Horizontal patch radius in pixels (FFmpeg allows up to 100)

params.name: sizeh
params.description: Vertical patch radius in pixels (FFmpeg allows up to 100)

params.name: stepw
params.description: Horizontal step between compared pixels (FFmpeg allows up to 50)

params.name: steph
params.description: Vertical step between compared pixels (FFmpeg allows up to 50)

params.name: threy
params.description: Threshold on the Y difference, 0..255 scale

params.name: threu
params.description: Threshold on the U difference, 0..255 scale

params.name: threv
params.description: Threshold on the V difference, 0..255 scale
